CANTEEN ROSTER FOR WEEK COMMENCING Monday 25th October 2010 
HAVE YOUR SAY ON PUBLIC TRANSPORT IN YOUR LOCAL COMMUNITY 
ADVANCING PERTH’S EASTERN REGION 
Seven Public Transport Forums are being held across the region during October and November 
2010. These forums aim to engage and encourage the community to become more aware of the 
vision for increased public transport and the options and delivery modes that exist. You can 
register by contacting Samantha Robshaw on email samantha.robshaw@emrc.org.au 
 
 
 
 
On Monday 18th October, approximately 500 members 
of our Chisholm community gathered to acknowledge 
some of the wonderful team and individual sporting 
performances for 2010.  Special guests Ms Shae Bolton 
(West Coast Fever Netball) and  
Mr Trent Mitton (Kookaburras gold medalist at the 
recent Delhi Commonwealth Games) shared the night 
with our future sporting stars.  Both were able to offer 
some advice and inspiration for all who attended.   
Congratulations to all our award winners and in particular  
Justin Skowron who was awarded the “Peter Tonkin” award for the most outstanding 
Year 12 sports person.  
Well done to all of you. 
Mr Andrew Glover, Head of Sport 
STUDENT CONGRATULATIONS 
William Edge Year 11Laurence1 
William has been selected to represent WA in the upcoming All Australian 
Basketball Tour to USA. He will participate in several competitions on the West 
Coast of America and play against some of the best USA College Basketball Teams. The tour 
takes in LA, San Diego, Las Vegas and Phoenix and will last from 28th Nov to 23rd Dec. 
Well done William and good luck for the Tour. We are very proud of you. 
Trent with Lara Ameduri and 
Danika Vidakovich
